# statusdrift_locations (Data Source)

Fetches all monitoring locations.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

- `id` (String) Placeholder ID for Terraform state.
- `locations` (Attributes List) List of monitoring locations. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--locations))

### Nested Schema for `locations`

Read-Only:
